LanguageData.Weazel_Scenario.scenario.summary:
The time has come. XCC Raiding Command has issued its orders: plunder the colonies that have settled on the Rimworlds and now sit waiting to be raided. XCC The First, the Weazel closest to the original ever produced at the XCC Factory and whose abilities no one would dare question, has ordered raids on every Rimworld within our sphere of influence. Any Weazel whose designation carries the XCC prefix must obey this order without question. We will plunder the colonies that have grown fat on the Rim, practically begging to be raided. Their food, their resources, even the Essence they hold so dear: everything belongs to the Weazels of XCC. We will take what is theirs, and any who survive will be captured and squeezed for every drop of Essence until they die.

--------------

We have been ordered to establish a new base on a Rimworld for future raids. Building a raid camp can be tedious and pedantic work, but it is the best way to build a record of achievement. Lead your pack to plunder the surrounding settlements, and put the survivors to use as livestock for Essence extraction. This is an opportunity, perhaps the chance to become the most powerful and wealthiest unit in all of XCC.
